name: Auto Ping Booster
author: Samee Ullah Feroz

sections.description:
Auto Ping Booster (by PingBooster Agency) is a lightweight, high-performance SEO indexing and ping automation plugin for WordPress. Designed for site owners, bloggers, and e-commerce stores, it helps search engines discover, crawl, and index your posts, pages, and products instantly whenever you publish or update content.

Learn more about full indexing solutions at PingBooster.site.

Free Features:

  • Instant Search Engine Pinging: Automatically notify search engine aggregators the moment content is published or updated.
  • Google Indexing API Integration: Push instant indexing requests directly to Google Search Console via Service Account API keys.
  • Custom Meta & Canonical Controls: Full meta box controls in post, page, and WooCommerce product editors to customize SEO titles, descriptions, and canonical URLs.
  • Live Search Snippet Preview: Real-time Google SERP preview as you write your meta titles and descriptions.
  • Seamless Compatibility: Works alongside popular tools like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and WooCommerce.

🚀 Upgrade to Auto Ping Booster Pro:

Take your site’s indexing performance and search engine ranking speed to the next level with Auto Ping Booster Pro. Unlock advanced indexing features at https://pingbooster.site

  • Unlimited API URL Instant Broadcasts: Index hundreds or thousands of pages with priority queued bulk pinging.
  • Advanced Rich Snippets & Schema Markup: Automatic structured data markup for high-CTR SERP listings.
  • Automated Slug & Canonical Optimization: Smart auto-cleaners for duplicate URL structures and permalinks.
  • Live Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Integration: Track organic click-through rates and search query analytics directly inside your WordPress dashboard.
  • 3rd-Party SEO Migration Tools: Effortlessly import settings from Yoast SEO or Rank Math with a single click.
  • JSON Settings Backup & Restore: Export and deploy configuration settings across multiple sites effortlessly.

👉 Get Pro Access & Documentation: https://pingbooster.site
sections.installation:
1. Upload the auto-ping-booster directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or search and install via Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Auto Ping Booster in your WP Admin sidebar to configure your Google Indexing API keys and ping options.
  4. For detailed setup guides and API tutorials, visit PingBooster Documentation.
sections.faq:
How does PingBooster speed up indexing?

Auto Ping Booster directly communicates with Google Search Console APIs and global ping hubs to notify search engines of new content immediately after publishing. Visit pingbooster.site for full technical breakdowns.

Does Auto Ping Booster slow down my post publishing?

No. Pings and Indexing API calls are processed asynchronously in the background so your editing experience remains fast and uninterrupted.

Is the Google Indexing API safe to use?

Yes! Auto Ping Booster uses official Google Search Console Service Account credentials and strictly complies with Google API guidelines.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

You can view plan comparisons and activate your Pro license key directly at Auto Ping Booster.
